title: Wet seasons against 1991 to 2020 (season_summary 1.0.0)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe season_summary 1.0.0 on bundle_chirps_monthly_ait_bouguemez: wet-season (November to April) catchment rainfall totals for the seasons starting November 2018 to November 2024, their departure from the mean of the 30 wet seasons starting November 1991 to November 2020, and their tercile category. Near-normal band 508.7 to 603.0 mm (reference seasons: 10 below, 10 near, 10 above).

The category places this wet season among the 30 seasons of 1991 to 2020 for this catchment's CHIRPS grid cells; it is not a drought index and says nothing about cause. Agreement compares directions only: a national statement can differ from one valley and still be correct for its own area. CHIRPS cells are estimates for 5 km squares, not rain gauge readings.

providers.name: Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara
Siterra science pipeline
providers.processing:lineage: Range reads of one full-resolution tile per monthly CHIRPS v3.0 final global COG; native cells intersecting the frozen catchment weighted by area inside it (EPSG:32629); catchment totals; 1991-2020 same-month means; departures (docs/reference/observation-preprocessing.md section 5).

season_summary.title: Season totals, departures, categories, reference totals and the near-normal band

siterra:dataset.resolution_note: Native 0.05 degree grid, about 4.7 km east to west by 5.5 km north to south here

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Planar area of the frozen polygon in EPSG:32629 (UTM 29N)

operation_order: S(y) = sum of catchment rainfall totals from November of year y to April of year y + 1
reference: S(y) for the 30 wet seasons starting November 1991 to November 2020, sorted x(1) <= ... <= x(30)
category = below_normal if S < L; above_normal if S > U; otherwise near_normal
D = S - mean of the 30 reference totals, in mm

siterra:checks.name: period_alignment
siterra:checks.detail: Each season is November of year y to April of year y + 1; month totals use the rainfall bundle's period IDs and cell weights

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: A season with any missing month or cell would have no total; none is missing from 1991-11 to 2025-04

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Season totals in mm, sums of monthly catchment totals in mm

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: season_2021-11_2022-04 recomputed month by month from the raw windows and the published weights matches its stored total within 0.01 mm

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present
siterra:checks.detail: CHIRPS DOI and access date and the Copernicus DEM notice are in siterra:attribution
